svg.title: Of the 64 rule changes in its log, the atlas codes 24 as moving the rules toward voters and 24 as moving them away.
svg.desc: A unit chart with one square for each of the 64 entries in the atlas’s repair log, placed by year. The atlas codes 24 entries toward voters, above the year line, and 24 away from voters, below it; 16 went neither way. Most entries fall in 2024 to 2026, and 2026 holds the most moves away from voters.
svg.text: Voters kept existing rules: a ballot measure failed
